_meta.description: Grouped Process aggregating revenue by region decorated with an OVERLAY_ZSCORE_VS_TOTAL group overlay that standardises each region's revenue against the per-region distribution's mean + POPULATION SD (sqrt(M2 / N)) folded across all present groups. Streamable — the Welford accumulator is one (count, mean, M2) triple carried alongside the per-group accumulators inside the streaming Process fold. Third and final streamable overlay in the E3 grouped-Process subset (siblings: OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_TOTAL / 06_process_index_vs_total.json, OVERLAY_SHARE_OF_TOTAL SERIES dispatch). Implicit-grand-total — Ref must be empty. Variance choice (POPULATION, not sample) intentional: the per-group aggregation set IS the whole population we are standardising against. Zero-variance emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO. Renderers centre diverging colour ramps on baseline = 0.
